scope:
Compare rigid-guide contact using converged beam-mapped CAD tessellations.

Uses saved 500 g equilibria; does not re-solve contact, mounting stiffness or
control. An axial surface resolution is distinct from the eight-cell rod mesh.

guide_design.status: socket-relief engineering candidate; not released for manufacture
guide_design.axial_retention: Outer-web stations: only the central 0.5 mm land is a proposed bond zone; flared mouths are unbonded relief. Inner-web stations retain the V2 socket. Bond strength and retention are unvalidated.
guide_design.adhesive: Unspecified pending PA12 surface preparation, actual bond gap and pull/shear coupon tests
guide_design.radial_retention: Removable inward socket caps retained by 0.35 mm stainless lockwire in a 0.45 mm groove; CAD models a conservative square-section wire envelope, closure tail excluded.
guide_design.mounting_webs: CAD-derived rectangular webs: radius ~6.896 mm at +/-24 mm stations, ~19.229 mm at +/-12 mm; sockets follow the actual web slope.
guide_design.mounting_stiffness: Four webs remain connected by a rigid frame. No claim that relief decouples their motion or preserves homogenised stiffness.
guide_design.body_source: ../guides_v2; unchanged module bodies, disks, anchors and 21/24/28 mm lanes
